title: Active ingredients of Erhuang Quzhi Granules for treating non-alcoholic fatty liver disease based on the NF-kappaB/NLRP3 pathway.
authors: Li, Si; Ma, Yue; Chen, Wen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方治疗脂肪肝的活性成分，虽用分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Erhuang Quzhi Granules (EQG), the Chinese herbal compound, has demonstrated significant clinical efficacy in treating non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD). The mechanism of this treatment has been shown to involve the nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB)/nod-like receptor thermal protein domain associated protein 3 (NLRP3) pathway. However, research on the material basis of EQG against NAFLD is still in its primary stages. Following these considerations, this study predicted and screened the active ingredients of EQG using the absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion (ADME) property evaluation tool and molecular docking. Then the levels of these active ingredients in EQG were measured using ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography (UHPLC). The efficacy of the active ingredients and their mechanisms were validated through both in vivo and in vitro experiments. The results indicate that the collected 12 components have favorable metabolic stability, are safe, and have drug-like properties. Aloe-emodin (AE), rhein (RH), curcumin (CUR), emodin (EM), and chrysophanol (CP) showed better binding affinity with TNF-alpha and Caspase-1 proteins. UHPLC analysis revealed that EQG contains AE, RH, CUR, EM, and CP. Cellular experiments proved that all these five ingredients reduce the accumulation of lipids and reactive oxygen species. In animal models of NAFLD, AE, and RH significantly improved the pathological symptoms of steatosis and fibrosis and reduced the levels of pro-inflammatory factors via the NF-kappaB/NLRP3 pathway. The results reveal the active ingredients of EQG for treating NAFLD based on the NF-kappaB/NLRP3 pathway and lay the foundation for the clinical promotion of EQG.
abstract_zh: 二黄去脂颗粒（EQG）作为一种中药复方，在治疗非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）方面显示出显著的临床疗效。其治疗机制已被证明涉及核因子κB（NF-kappaB）/NOD样受体热蛋白结构域相关蛋白3（NLRP3）通路。然而，关于EQG抗NAFLD物质基础的研究仍处于初步阶段。基于上述考虑，本研究利用吸收、分布、代谢和排泄（ADME）性质评估工具及分子对接技术，对EQG的活性成分进行了预测和筛选。随后，采用超高效液相色谱（UHPLC）测定了EQG中这些活性成分的含量。通过体内和体外实验验证了活性成分的疗效及其作用机制。结果表明，所收集的12种成分具有良好的代谢稳定性、安全性及类药性。芦荟大黄素（AE）、大黄酸（RH）、姜黄素（CUR）、大黄素（EM）和大黄酚（CP）与TNF-alpha和Caspase-1蛋白表现出较好的结合亲和力。UHPLC分析显示，EQG中含有AE、RH、CUR、EM和CP。细胞实验证明，这五种成分均能减少脂质和活性氧的积累。在NAFLD动物模型中，AE和RH通过NF-kappaB/NLRP3通路显著改善了脂肪变性和纤维化的病理症状，并降低了促炎因子的水平。这些结果揭示了EQG基于NF-kappaB/NLRP3通路治疗NAFLD的活性成分，为EQG的临床推广奠定了基础。
